svg.title: Reader exact match on sealed v3
svg.desc: Recorded sealed-v3 reader counts and gate outcomes. The adopted reader passed R1 and missed R2 and R3.

svg.text: Reader exact match on sealed v3
Locked before tuning; scored once. Recorded results. Synthetic ships and cargo, simulated port.
Glimmer: same model, same laptop, with and without fine-tuning, under the same mask.
Muse Spark reference: 126/128 (98.44%)
Fixed original Spark reference; not rerun under the updated decoder.
Adopted v3 Reader
Untrained Glimmer
No-model parser
Reader / comparator
Exact / sentences
Exact-match sentences (%)
Adopted v3: passed the 90% gate; missed both stricter gates.
R1 PASS: 92.19% exact; minimum 90% (blue dashed line).
R2 FAIL: 1/48 loosening sentences accepted; maximum 0 allowed.
R3 FAIL: 6.25 points below Spark; maximum 3 allowed.
R3 minimum 95.44% exact (orange dotted line); Spark is purple, long dashed.
Adoption context (D266): v3 118/128, 1/48 loosening accepted; v2 120/128, 2/48 loosening accepted.
v3 was adopted for better refusal of unsupported sentences, with two fewer exact matches.
Sources: final-adoption-d266.json; sealed-summary.json; parser/sealed-v3-report.json; sealed/spark-summary.json.
Source paths and SHA-256 hashes are embedded and listed in the chart README.
